title: Gemini Notebook Slide Decks and Videos

activities.title: Quick check: a claim that is not in the report

blocks.prompt: Gemini Notebook made a slide saying the drop in hard-to-find memos was "driven directly" by the naming rule. Your report only gives the numbers. What do you do?
options: Keep it. The AI read the whole report
Revise that slide so it says only what the report says
Delete the whole deck and type it again by hand
Present it, and say it was made by AI
